notes.title: Development roadmap & mini-fix (patch v0.3.0.2)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 



Now that the demo is out, wanted to share with you all some info about what is coming next. 


Dev Roadmap
I will now be gradually improving upon the demo, while bringing the rest of the game to completion. What you can expect in terms of demo updates in the future (not necessarily in that order):   

Various QoL improvements, bug fixes and proper save system

More types of Corporation upgrades and additional character dialogues

Expanded roster of Avowed that you can play with

More varied level objectives and Slums levels configurations

Implementation of more Avowed talents/gambits, and potential changes to the class systems

On the last point, I am still pondering whether the current class change system really works or not in terms of fun & strategic layer. So I might revisit this mechanic.

As for the timeline for all these updates... well they will come when ready ! There are still a few inhouse tools I need to develop to help with balancing out the game overall. So will see how all these things play out.


Patch v0.3.0.2
As for now, I just uploaded a small patch which addresses two points:

Bug: fixed a glitch in the fighting system that froze the game. Thanks to those who pointed that out

QoL: made the tutorial popups closable by simply clicking on them (vs having to click on the red X)   



That is all for today ! Thanks again for all the support and hope you will like what is coming.



Cheers

Ervya

notes.title: Patch (v0.3.0.1) - Hotfixing !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thanks for the support with the demo launch yesterday ! It is really heartwarming to see the game I have been working on for so long now being played by many of you :)

Patch (v0.3.0.1) 
Short update as I just uploaded a small patch correcting two bugs reported by players. The bugs happened during fights, and only happened if a very specific combination of events occured. But one of them induced a game freeze, so now it is fixed !


All feedback welcome 
Also wanted to ask everyone to please share with me any feedback or bug you find in the game. You can use the "Feedback" button in game for that purpose, and that would really help me a ton in polishing this game to make it really something special !


Thanks again for the support. Will be sharing a development roadmap for the next few months in my next post !

Cheers
Ervya

notes.title: Dev Update - The Tower City of Shavanath
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After posting last time about the battle mechanics of Rain Tactics, wanted to give a bit more info about the lore of the game and its world setting.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725810/c994438ced27ad83ea7287266e04d9b52f7468ba.png
Picture: preview of the new Shavanath navigation screen, with 3 SEN lines displayed

[olist]
 Overall game setting
Rain Tactics takes place in a futuristic, cyberpunk world where large corporates emerged as the main organizing units of societies. Globalization of trade and international information exchange have grown exponentially. But culture and values remain mostly dictated by the ruling corporates in place, who wage a constant economic war between them.

With time, magic which was once hidden to the crowd have now been unearthed with the resurgence of long forgotten deities who have decided to take an active part to the restructuring of the world. As such, the game follows Winter, an invincible god whose impact on the world has once been tremendous in shaping the rise and fall of civilizations.

 The Tower City of Shavanath - a short history:
The city of Shavanath, located in an island in the middle of the Atlantic ocean, is one of the few places that managed to escape the rule of the AAA corporations. This uniqueness is the result of the arrival of the mysterious Lady of the Dark, who engulfed Shavanath in a mist of darkness and propelled the construction of what is now an independant Tower City, some seventy years ago.

The city is today considered a "neutral state". Its borders are open to all who accept to abide by the Mistress' rules. And most foreign corporations have setup local branches to capture a share of this 50 mn people market.


 The main suburbs of Shavanath:
Modern Shavanath is today structured in three main suburbs. 

The Slums constitute the lowest section of the tower city. One could typically describe them as a collection of low-life quarters where resides the workforce which maintains the city and handles its logistics. Most of these operations are unofficially managed by the Red Dragons, a local mafia gang. 

The Circle makes up the opulent suburbs that constitute the main part of the Tower. From luxurious resorts to trendy bars and fashion streets, The Circle boasts all the entertainment & services the wealthy citizens of Shavanath can dream of. Today, most of them are either working for a corporate local branch or for the powerful town administration office. 

Finally the top of the Tower City is dedicated to the Inner Sanctum, where the Mistress is said to be residing and where lies the Heart of Dark. This section of the city is off-limit to regular citizens - only a few privileged have ever set foot there. The Mistress having not been seen in decades, some say she never existed in the first place and is just a construct from the town administrators to ensure the city cohesion and rule of law. But this is probably just a despicable rumor spread as part of a corporate scheme, as who could deny the power of the Dark over the city?

 Exploring Shavanath in Rain Tactics
Winter has undergone a long journey in order to reach Shavanath and seek an audience with the Lady of the Dark. Unfortunately, Winter will have to go through various parts of the city to reach the Inner Sanctum. For that purpose, the player will get access to the Shavanath Elevator Network - or S.E.N - to quickly navigate through the city. But the Network connections are not open to all, and so access will have to be gained. Sometimes by force.

[/olist]

So that concludes this brief intro to the overall setting of Rain Tactics.
Next chapter, will come back with some update around the demo and what it will contain!

Thanks to all of you for your support.

Ervya

Picture: screenshot of Eden's Garden, a sanctuary for dreamers, rebels, and well-hidden secrets, nested in the middle of Shavanath's Circle

notes.title: Dev Update - Battle System
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

As announced in my last post, I wanted to give you an update on the main changes being implemented on Rain Tactics based on last year playtest.

As there is a ton of elements to cover, this first post will focus on the current state of the battle system, so that you know what to expect at the next playtest / for the demo release. Hope many of you will get the opportunity to try this out !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44725810/449c61c59435dc564f055a707382c69d3dced76e.jpgPicture: updated screen of Winter about to attack a Red Dragon's scum, with battle simulation UI


So about the battle system:
[olist]
 Combat system - the Core:

 The fundamentals of the combat system rely on two pillars: a turn-based fighting mechanic, and a class system
 The turn-based mechanic, heavily inspired from classic sRPGs:

 Turn system: player and enemy units act in separate turns. Turn is over once all units from one party have acted
 Auto-retaliation mechanic: a unit can typically attack one adversary, while the adversary has the opportunity to retaliate
 Weapon triangle: a unit hit rate depends on the attacker / defender stats, but also on the type of weapons they are using
 The class system:

 Each character has an archetype that gives him/her access to 3 classes and some unique talents
 The talents typically provide interaction options (like the ability to hack computer systems) , passive effects (see in the dark), or gimmicks on how to use the unit
 Each class gives access to up to 5 abilities (whether attacks or heals) that can be learned and upgraded throughout a run
 Each character in the roster can decide which class to embody at the beginning of a level, giving the opportunity to the player to adapt the team skills to the challenge ahead

 The tactical twists, giving more depth to the Core:

 Unit direction: will now influence a unit likeliness to get hit or not (backstabbing having a higher crit chance); giving more tactical weights to player's choice
 Unit location: similarly, unit can get "cover" from surrounding objects, and can benefit/suffer from some areas effects (e.g mud slowing down movement)
 AoE attacks: as in many regular t-RPG, some abilities now have the option to target multiple opponents; in that case, the "main target" will have the opportunity to retaliate against the attacker, while the others will be hit by a remnant effect (understand "weakened" version of the main attack - trying to balance things out here!). These attacks typically cost Energy Points, a rare resource in the game that allows you to use these powerful abilities
 Opportunity attacks: sandwiching an enemy will give the opportunity for two units to attack an enemy successively (before the enemy retaliates). Considering the important advantage this gives, this is not an automatic setup, but more of a coordinated attack that requires Energy Points
 Winter's Curse: each of Winter's Avowed (team members) can receive a temporary buff from Winter before launching an attack, at the cost of some of Winter's own self control...

 The strategic Element: managing Winter's self control

 Your main objective is to bring Winter to Shavanath's top floor where he will get access to the Gate of Oblivion
 As such, Winter is always part of your starting team; he is both your trump card and vulnerable point
 Winter as trump card: Winter is invincible and as such can act as a tank; furthermore, you can unleash his powers to one-shot almost any enemy or to strike with some of the most powerful AoE attacks in the game
 Winter as a vulnerable point: but relying on Winter's power has a price; it will bring his self-control down, which you need to avoid at all cost
 So it will be up to you to decide when to best rely on Winter's powers to clear the way through !

[/olist]
And that is basically the current state of the battle system. Sorry for the long post but thought it was useful (even for me !) to synthesize all this in a few lines. I also realize that a couple clips would make it easier to grasp the different elements. I will be soon be creating a short thread on Twitter @ErvyaStudios to illustrate all this !

I am constantly trying to deepen the tactical choices the player can make, while keeping the system not too complicated. So feel free to share thoughts, and hope many of you will get the opportunity to test this soon.

In the next post, I will be sharing more info about the tower-city of Shavanath and how to explore it!
Thanks to all of you for your support !

Ervya

notes.title: Happy holidays || a short update on Rain Tactics
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Hope you are all enjoying some well deserved time-off during the winter break.
From my side, as the end of the year is drawing near, I thought it was a good time to give you all an update on Rain Tactics' development.


As some of you may know, I conducted a playtest of Rain Tactics in May which was a great opportunity for me to receive early feedback on the demo. So first, wanted to thank all the people who took the time to play the game and give some input. It really was super helpful and quite exciting for me to get the demo live online !
Main points of feedback are the following:
[olist]
 Expand the battle system: by providing the playable characters with more abilities early on, by enabling more interactions between characters, and by making enemies more active
 Give incentive to continue beyond the tutorial: by revising the tutorial setup and introducing additional characters early on
 Make the demo less punishing: by revising the difficulty and relying less on "Hit/Miss" mechanics
[/olist]

All these inputs have convinced me to take the time to further improve the demo. Most of the updates I am implementing are either about i) addressing feedback received or ii) adding some content I did not have the time to put into the initial playtest (like allies quests). I will write a separate post to detail all the changes/ additions but as you may have guessed; this is taking a bit of time. So while I was hoping to release the demo by end of 2024, I am sorry to postpone (and this time, i will not abide by a specific timeline, I just want to take the time to make it right).


So all this to tell you all that Rain Tactics development is progressing, that I am really grateful for your support, and that I wish you all a great end of 2024 / wonderful 2025. Will try to post a bit more next year !

Happy Holidays
Ervya
